title: World entity
description: One thing in the world at some rung of the scale ladder, together with an honest statement of where its values came from.

id.description: Stable, hierarchical, permanent. Never renumbered, never reused. A retired id is tombstoned, not recycled.

level.description: Rung of the scale ladder. See packages/schema/scale-ladder.json.

parent.description: id of the containing entity; null only for IN.

geometry_ref.description: Reference into the pack's geometry store. Null below level 14, where geometry is generated.

field_provenance.description: Per-field override of the entity-level provenance. A village may hold a SOURCED population and a SYNTHESIZED street layout.

as_of.description: The date the values describe, not the date they were authored.

source.description: Required when provenance is SOURCED or DERIVED.

seed.description: Required when provenance is SYNTHESIZED. Hashed with the world seed to drive worldgen.

fields.description: Simulation payload. Shape depends on kind.

constraints.description: Marginals this entity's children must be fitted to. Consumed by iterative proportional fitting; see docs/02-data-spine.md section 2.

tombstone.description: Set when this id is retired. Decisions referencing it follow the remap.

provenance.description: SOURCED: real, cited. DERIVED: computed from sourced data. SYNTHESIZED: deterministically invented by worldgen. ABSENT: explicitly unknown; renders as unsurveyed.
